name: Get the Goblins Drunk

meta.previous: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
prev_q: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout

summary: Kravel Koalbeard wants the Fool's Stout tested on a pit crew at the Mirage Raceway. If you choose the goblins, you take the stout to the Goblin Pit Boss. The stout will go bad eventually, so Kravel says not to wait too long.

sections.title: A Test on the Pit Crews
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard needs the Fool's Stout tried out on one of the pit crews. You may try it on the goblins: he hands you the stout and sends you with it to the Goblin Pit Boss, who is nearby at the Mirage Raceway. Choosing the goblins tips the races toward the gnomes. Kravel warns you not to dawdle, because the stout will go bad eventually.

sections.title: A Little Won't Hurt
sections.body: The Goblin Pit Boss sees booze on offer and does not mind having a little.

aliases: who gives get the goblins drunk
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, the dwarf at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Where must the stout be taken?
faq.answer: To the Goblin Pit Boss, who is nearby at the Mirage Raceway.

faq.q: What happens if you wait too long?
faq.answer: The stout will go bad eventually, so Kravel tells you not to wait too long.

faq.q: What is the alternative to this?
faq.answer: Kravel lets you pick which pit crew to try the stout on. The other choice is Get the Gnomes Drunk, with the gnome crew.

aliases: prereq for get the goblins drunk
faq.answer: It follows Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout.

faq.q: What comes after the stout is delivered?
aliases: what comes after get the goblins drunk
faq.answer: The chain continues with Report Back to Fizzlebub.
